title: 48-year-old accountant with isolated writing difficulty

provenance.citation: Synthetic case drafted 2026-10-17 for Rare Disease Detective; not derived from any individual patient.

chief_complaint: "For three years my hand cramps and twists whenever I write. Typing is fine."
history_of_present_illness: Three years of right-hand cramping, excessive grip, and wrist flexion that begins within a few words of handwriting and does not occur with typing, eating, or other tasks. Stable over the past 18 months. No diurnal variation, no benefit after sleep. No involvement of other body parts. Changing pen grip helps briefly.

movement_findings.observation: Writing: excessive pen grip, wrist flexion and pronation within first line.
Typing, buttoning, and using cutlery: normal.
No tremor, no dystonia at rest or posture.

neurological_exam.other: Normal examination outside the writing task
